Bartok party blinis and goat's cheese figs
the Bartok press party where Seth meets Veronica

Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, alongside fresh figs stuffed with goat's cheese and drizzled with honey and thyme. Warm 16 store-bought blinis at 180C for 5 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche from 150g, a fold of smoked salmon from 150g, a dill sprig and lemon zest. Cut a cross in the tops of 6 figs and press in 120g soft goat's cheese. Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey, scatter thyme leaves and grill 2 minutes until warm. Serve both on a tray.
M: Veronica says the teleported steak tastes synthetic

Dry-aged style rib eye seared in cast iron and pulled medium rare, with a proper béarnaise, crispy potatoes and dressed watercress, the real thing. Salt 2 large rib eye steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast 1kg diced potatoes in oil at 220C for 40 minutes. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar over simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in 150g melted butter, add chopped tarragon and salt. Sear the steaks in smoking cast iron, flipping every minute, to 52C, rest 8 minutes and slice. Serve with watercress dressed in oil and lemon.
everything Seth eats now needs sugar
Pork belly roasted at 150C for 2 hours, then glazed with soy, honey, brown sugar and ginger under a hot grill until sticky. Steamed rice and greens.
W: Pears baked in butter, brown sugar and vanilla until soft and sticky, with cream. Halve 4 pears and core.
K: Seth spoons in sugar until the coffee is syrup

Espresso shaken with a dark brown sugar syrup and ice, poured over cold milk with a cap of sweet cream, for when the sugar cravings kick in. Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 100ml water for 2 minutes to make a syrup and cool. Brew 4 double espressos (or 250ml very strong coffee). Shake each shot with 25ml syrup and a handful of ice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, pour over the coffee and top with 2 tbsp lightly whipped cream.

s.note: the first steak through the pods tastes synthetic
s.how: Cut 600g sirloin into cubes and season well. Sear in a smoking pan in batches, then baste with 40g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme. Rest 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tbsp horseradish. Serve on toothpicks.

Mix 350g flour, 7g yeast, 40g butter, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 180ml warm water and rest an hour. Roll out, cut rounds and prove 30 minutes. Fry at 175C for 90 seconds a side and toss in 100g caster sugar while warm.

m.note: everything Seth eats now needs sugar
m.how: Roast 1kg pork belly at 150C for 2 hours. Simmer 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger until syrupy. Slice the pork, brush with glaze and grill until sticky. Serve with 300g steamed rice and greens.

w.how: Halve 4 pears and core. Lay cut side up in a dish with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar, a split vanilla bean and 100ml water. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes, basting, and serve with cream.
